browser_result.summary: Intel faces severe financial stress: negative earnings, thin operating margins, negative free cash flow, and a debt load exceeding liquid assets by ~$51B, while Fitch has downgraded its IDR to BBB with a negative outlook. Key risks include persistent foundry operating losses, AI market share erosion, and U.S. export controls on China. Actionable next steps are to monitor quarterly foundry margin progress, cash flow and debt repayment milestones, and any updates on export license impacts. A gap is the lack of segment-level profitability detail in the summaries, so request the 10-Q’s foundry and Mobileye segment disclosures to model turnaround viability.
